transcript.text: Now I have all needed context: focus region = West, calendar year 2025, net revenue = amount - discount over completed orders. Let me query using order_ts's actual timestamp with timezone (order_ts appears to include timezone offset).

args.sql:
SELECT SUM(o.amount - o.discount) AS net_revenue_cents, COUNT(*) AS n
FROM memory.bench.orders o
JOIN memory.bench.customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
WHERE c.region = 'West'
  AND o.status = 'completed'
  AND o.order_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01 00:00:00'
  AND o.order_ts < TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01 00:00:00'
